$comment: Requirement IDs: ASM-01, ASM-04, ASM-RES-01, ADV-02, GOV-MIN-02, GOV-MIN-03, XCUT-08 | Single source: master_blueprint.md §4 #6 | Frozen verbatim from design_documents/design_plans/DP-G-assembly-advisory-tooling.md §3.3 | Contract #6 — single source for PROV-01, DOCTOR-REU-01, DECKGEN-03, SCRIPT-02, FAQDEF-02, TRACK-01, SUBMIT, BENCH.
title: AssemblyManifest
description: Contract #6 ASM-01/ASM-04 — single source for PROV, DOCTOR, DECKGEN, TRACK, BENCH. Sub-component granularity via id like media/stt (6.17) with top-level default grouping.

manifest_version.description: SemVer of this manifest schema itself (e.g. 1.0.0). Consumers pin MAJOR. Adding optional field = MINOR, removing/renaming required = MAJOR + MIGRATION.md.

chassis_version.description: Chassis version — git sha (40 hex) or SemVer tag (e.g. v1.2.0 or abc1234). Resolved from git rev-parse HEAD at assembly time.

components.description: One entry per component/sub-component. Supports 6.17 granularity: id may be top-level (12) or slash sub-component. Each entry declares inclusion + requirements.

id.description: Closed enum — top-level or sub-component. Slash form selects finer granularity; parent group is default grouping.

included.description: True = include in working copy; false = excluded (still documented via selection_rationale).

version.description: Component version at assembly time (SemVer). Mirrors chassis tag for now; per-component pinning future via MINOR.

requires_env.description: Env var names this component requires when included (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY). Empty when none. Source of truth for DOCTOR-REU-01.

requires_providers.description: Provider/service names (e.g. openai, anthropic, vercel, replicate). Empty when none. Used by PROV-01 disclosure and COST/TRACK.

selection_rationale.description: One entry per top-level component (12) — ADV-02 requires rationale for every include AND every exclude, including PGM/PROFILE rationale-skipped.

id.description: Top-level component id (12 ids only, not slash sub-components). Mirrors components[] parent when sub-components exist.

reason.description: One-line rationale citing specific brief text for include (GOV-MIN-03), or clear skip reason. Must reference brief excerpt for ADV-AC-03.

baseline_commit.description: SHA of baseline commit after ASM-06 (null before init).
